name: Hida (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hida city emblem in white: a stylised device of concentric arcs, like a mountain range.
history: Municipal flag of Hida, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 February 2004.

features.role: Hida city emblem — a stylised device of concentric arcs, like a mountain range
